import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date to datetime
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Total Sales by Product (Top Left)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars1 = ax1.barh(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors[:len(product_sales)])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
for bar, value in zip(bars1, product_sales.values):
    ax1.text(value + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${value:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales Distribution by Customer Age Group (Top Right)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(age_sales)],
                                    explode=[0.02]*len(age_sales), startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(autotexts, size=9, weight='bold')

# 3. Average Transaction by Size and Payment Method (Bottom Left)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='size', columns='payment_method', 
                            aggfunc='mean').reindex(size_order)
pivot_data.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, color=colors[:3], edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Avg Transaction by Size & Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Payment Method', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_xticklabels(size_order, rotation=0)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 4. Daily Sales Trend (Bottom Right)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], color=colors[0], linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.7)
ax4.fill_between(daily_sales['date'], daily_sales['total'], alpha=0.3, color=colors[0])

# Add rolling average
rolling_avg = daily_sales['total'].rolling(window=7).mean()
ax4.plot(daily_sales['date'], rolling_avg, color=colors[3], linewidth=2, 
         label='7-day Moving Avg', linestyle='--')

ax4.set_xlabel('Date', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Daily Sales ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Daily Sales Trend with 7-Day Moving Average', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
